verdict.rationale: incident.io has a dedicated follow-ups feature explicitly designed to capture and track post-incident actions to completion (docs-7, docs-68, docs-80), and documents exporting/syncing these follow-ups as issues in GitHub and GitLab with bidirectional change sync, plus Asana integration (intdir-1, intdir-2, docs-74), and changelog notes on ticket-incident sync (docs-88). This directly matches the engineering-leader story of tracking follow-ups to completion with issue-tracker sync. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of sync reliability, and no evidence of Jira-specific sync (only GitHub/GitLab/Asana named).
